1028090817855074304.epitaph:
I was a walking excavator with my arms and legs, digging in the soil of my heart. Now I’m just a walking excavator. And you, the one who saw me, I still remember. You never left me. I’ve been with you through the years.

If you still want to be with me, let’s walk through the world together.
